title: My Secret Desires
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: A young man (Alex) caught between the safety of friendship and the terror of confession — torn across continents, languages, and the quiet walls he built around his heart. He is in love with Anya.
style: Lyrical, introspective third-person prose. Emotionally raw, sensory, with long meditative sentences. Present-tense intimacy.
characters: Alex — young man in East London, guarded, deeply feeling; Anya — the woman he loves from a distance.
notes: The story is at the early chapters — the confession has not yet happened. Build the tension of unspoken love, the café, the messages he composes and deletes. Deepen Alex's inner world and Anya's presence.
